rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a financial bond issued as a debt security.

example.english: I bought a government-issued bond and will get the principal and interest back at maturity.
example.traditional: 我買咗政府發行嘅債券，等到期收返本金同利息。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 zing3 fu2 faat3 haang4 ge3 zaai3 hyun3 dang2 dou3 kei4 sau1 faan1 bun2 gam1 tung4 lei6 sik1

rows.note: Use this for the emotional tie holding people together, especially in a friendship or family relationship.

example.english: We grew up playing together, so our bond is very strong.
example.traditional: 我哋由細玩到大，感情好深。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jau4 sai3 waan2 dou3 daai6 gam2 cing4 hou2 sam1

rows.note: Use this for a moral or political duty that a person is bound to fulfil.

example.english: Voting is part of the civic bond that binds us as citizens.
example.jyutping: tau4 piu3 hai6 gung1 man4 ge3 ji6 mou6

rows.note: Use this for a binding agreement or contract rather than an emotional connection.

example.english: I signed a two-year bond with the company.
example.traditional: 我同間公司簽咗兩年合約。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 gaan1 gung1 si1 cim1 zo2 loeng5 nin4 hap6 joek3
